rows.question: How much operating income did the Google Cloud segment earn in the fourth quarter of 2025?
rows.answer:
To find the operating income of the Google Cloud segment in the fourth quarter of 2025, we subtract the operating income for the first nine months of 2025 from the full-year 2025 operating income. 
Full-year 2025 Google Cloud operating income = $13,910 million (Passage 7 and 9).
Nine months ended September 30, 2025 Google Cloud operating income = $8,597 million (Passage 10).
$13,910 million - $8,597 million = $5,313 million (or $5,313,000,000).
rows.gold: About $5,313 million: full-year 2025 Google Cloud operating income of $13,910 million minus $8,597 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
